learning_objective: 🎯 Let us play with multiplication and division by making fair and equal groups of our favorite things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If you have 3 boxes, and each box has 4 chocolates, you can add 4+4+4 or just multiply 3 x 4 to get 12 fast! It means having groups of the same size.
Division means sharing things equally so nobody gets upset! If you have 10 toys and 2 friends, you give 5 toys to each friend.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🤝 Multiplication and Division are Best Friends
main_concepts.simple_explanation: They work together like magic! If 3 x 4 = 12, then 12 divided by 4 brings you back to 3. They are opposite actions.

fun_activity.title: 🍪 Biscuit Grouping
fun_activity.instructions: Take 12 biscuits. Try to put them in equal groups of 2, then equal groups of 3, and then equal groups of 4. Draw what your groups look like!

quick_recap: ⭐ Multiplication helps us add the same number quickly.
⭐ Division helps us split a big group into smaller equal groups.
⭐ An equal group means every group has the exact same number of items.
